title: harness.json
description: Per-project contract for the harness plugin, committed at <project>/.claude/harness.json. Every key is optional; plugins/harness/config/defaults.json fills the rest. Objects merge key by key; arrays and scalars replace.

harness_version.description: Plugin VERSION the pinned schema copy was synced from.

base_branch.description: PR base branch; null resolves origin/HEAD, else main.

integration_branches.description: Branches d-w fetches from origin before cutting; empty means [base_branch, main].

skills_dir.description: Where this project keeps its own skills (review lens detection).

schemas_dir.description: Pinned schema copy; resolved before the plugin's schemas/.

state_dir.description: Runtime state (sentinels, pr-team runtime). Gitignore it.

matrix_path.description: pr-review invocation test matrix JSONL (repo data).

agent_usage_path.description: pr-review-watch agent usage JSONL: one row per dispatch of a defined agent (repo data).

exclusions.description: Machine-generated exclusions JSON; written on first use when left at the default path and absent; null disables exclusion filtering.

file_pattern.description: Regex a repo-relative POSIX path must match to count as a test file.

registry.description: Test registry JSON; null means none.

registry_names.description: File names that count as registry files for review bucketing.

timings.description: Test timing report JSON: rows under tests with file (repo-relative) and duration (seconds), summed per file; a row's file must equal the registry entry's file exactly (same characters, forward slashes, no ./ prefix, no ::nodeid suffix) or its time is not matched; null means none.

fixer_test_seconds.description: pr-review fixers defer a registered test whose summed timings exceed this many seconds; null disables the runtime rule.

defer_flags.description: Dotted paths into a registry entry (e.g. properties.super_slow); a test whose value at any of them is true is deferred out of fixer runs.

serial_flags.description: Dotted paths into a registry entry (e.g. properties.licensed); fixers whose file sets reach tests that are true at the same path are planned into different waves (or one fixer), so those tests never run at the same time.

local_test_pattern.description: Touched paths matching this regex add local_guards to the structural guard run.

lenses.description: Project lens catalog merged over the plugin's generic lenses.

pointer.description: Rule text added to a reviewer brief whose scope touches prefix.

tracking_paths.description: fnmatch globs over repo-relative POSIX paths of tracking documents (plans, trackers). fnmatch `*` crosses `/`, so `docs/*.md` also matches nested files. No pr-review fixer owns them: an issue whose files are all tracking is left to the main session (closeout --resolved), and a path a fix option names never joins a fixer's file set.

commit_buckets.description: Ordered path rules for commit grouping; first match wins.

auto_approve_python_c.description: Auto-approve `python -c` Bash commands in this project.

worktree_root.description: Directory linked worktrees are created under; a leading ~ expands and {repo} is the main checkout's folder name. null: ~/.config/harness/worktrees/{repo}.

worktree_setup.description: Commands d-w runs, in order, in each new worktree (dependency install). Each command is an argv array, run without a shell; the first failure stops the list. A failure is reported, never fatal.

worktree_baseline.description: Commands d-w runs after worktree_setup succeeds, to record the test state before any change (name test files, never a directory). A failure is reported, never fatal.

runlogs.description: Where the project's run logs (test-runner or script console output) land; read by check-runlogs.

dir.description: Run-log folder; subfolders at any depth (e.g. dated archive folders) are searched too. null: check-runlogs needs --dir.

name_pattern.description: Regex a log file name must fully match; named group date (YYYY-MM-DD) required (checked at config load), time (HHMMSS) optional, a date-only name sorts as midnight.

todo.description: TODO catalog sync (todo_sync engine, todo-watch mod). Inactive while folder is null. Every other path is relative to folder ('..' allowed, but no path may climb above the project root: config load fails). A null key switches its rule group off. catalog_schema and research.catalog at their defaults are used only when present; a name the project sets must exist (config load fails). A missing TODO catalog is a T1 error and a missing snapshot a T2 warn.

folder.description: Project-relative folder holding the TODO catalog and its companions, inside the project root; setting it turns the feature on. null: off.

catalog.description: Ranked TODO catalog JSON (TodoCatalog shape), relative to folder.

catalog_schema.description: Project schema rule T1 validates the catalog against (its declared draft), relative to folder; the default name is used when the file exists, else (or when null) the harness catalogs/TodoCatalog.schema.json. A name set here must exist.

stub_name.description: File name of a research implementation stub under artifacts.research; null turns S1-S4 off.

top_n.description: Rows in the /todo summary table and the rendered snapshot.

dir.description: Folder render writes dated snapshots into and T2 reads the newest from, relative to folder; null turns T2 and render off.

name_pattern.description: Regex a snapshot file name must fully match; named group date required (checked at config load); newest by date, else mtime. render always writes TODO_Snapshot_YYYY_MMDD.md (fixed name), so this pattern must also fully match that name or render refuses.

catalog.description: Research implementation catalog JSON, relative to folder; the default name is used when the file exists, else (or when null) the S rules and T3-T5 are off. A name set here must exist. The research root is artifacts.research.

anchor_pattern.description: Regex a stub line matches to name its catalog entry; named group id required (checked at config load).

ignore_folders.description: Top-level research folders S6 does not require an entry for; the folders holding the catalog and the snapshots are excluded automatically.

pairs.description: Check ActionPlan / PIP pairs under artifacts.plans (rules P1-P4).

repo.description: owner/name the issue fetch reads; null: the origin remote. Phase 3: the fetch is not built yet, so no rule reads it today.

max_age_hours.description: Issue cache age past which G5 warns (Phase 3; no G rule runs yet) and the /todo summary line shows the age. The start notice does not show it.

warn_counts.description: Count warn findings toward the drift number.

inject_context.description: todo-watch adds a TODO_SYNC drift line to the prompt context when it changes.

notice.description: How todo-watch shows its session-start notice: the top items by rank, one per line, then one sync status line. Sync changes update the status line of a shown band and never show the notice again.

style.description: toast: a toast that leaves after toast_seconds (a click or the pointer over it also ends or holds it). banner: a band above the prompt, kept until its Dismiss button is pressed.

toast_seconds.description: Seconds a toast stays; 60 is the engine's ceiling. Unused with style banner.

items.description: How many top TODO items, by rank, the todo-watch notice lists.
